title: Achieve Font Consistency: Master CSS 'font-size-adjust' for Harmonized Web Fonts & UI Readability
tweet: Ensure visual harmony across web fonts! 💫 Master CSS 'font-size-adjust' to normalize x-heights, enhancing UI readability & user experience. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign #UXTips
tip: When working with multiple web fonts or defining fallback stacks, different fonts can have wildly varying x-heights even at the same 'font-size'. This discrepancy can disrupt visual rhythm and readability. 'font-size-adjust' allows you to normalize the x-height, ensuring consistent perceived font sizes and improving overall UI coherence, especially in text-heavy interfaces. Use it to specify a desired aspect value (ratio of x-height to font-size) for consistent visual density across your web fonts, whether primary or fallbacks.
